messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: prom-scrape-exporter-connection-failure (severity: P2)
Alert details: service=prometheus-scrape, instance=prom-exporter-ams-0, symptom=missing_scrapes > 5m
Links: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12345

PagerDuty: Auto-assign to Aditi (oncall) — escalation in 5m if unacknowledged

Aditi (oncall): Ack

Aditi (oncall): I'm looking. initial check: dashboards show missing `node_exporter` metrics for multiple hosts + log-ingest queue depth spiking. pinging infra.

Tom: saw same. `prom-scrape-job` shows 500 responses from exporter. can we `kubectl get pods -n monitoring | grep exporter`?

Lina: I can look at kafka consumer later, but if exporter is returning 500s it could be CPU lock or OOM.

Aditi (oncall): running `kubectl describe pod prometheus-exporter-0 -n monitoring` now

Aditi (oncall): describe shows crashloop at 03:12 UTC: `OOMKilled` then `BackOff`.

Tom: logs show repeated stacktrace and `panic: runtime: out of memory`
```
2026-03-14T03:10:11Z exporter.go:123] runtime: out of memory
panic: runtime: out of memory
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.main()
```

Aditi (oncall): scaling down scraping to avoid further errors: temporarily silence `prom-scrape-*` alerts for 15m (suppress via incident-bot)

incident-bot: Suppression applied: prom-scrape-exporter-connection-failure for 15m by Aditi (oncall)

Tom: I'll restart the exporter pod to clear memory. `kubectl delete pod prometheus-exporter-0 -n monitoring` -> new pod should spin up

Aditi (oncall): doing it

OpsRunbookBot: Runbook check: If exporter OOM, increase memory request to 512Mi and restart. If repeated, enable collector-level throttling. Link: https://runbooks.internal/prom-exporter

Tom: new pod is Pending -> ImagePullBackOff

Lina: weird, looks like the new image tag was deprecated. `ImagePullBackOff` with `manifest unknown`. Could explain sudden crashes if image mutated.

Aditi (oncall): rolling back to last healthy image tag `prom-exporter:v1.9.2`

Tom: patch applied, new pod is Running, logs look healthy: `exporter: scrape success`
```
2026-03-14T03:18:02Z exporter.go:89] scrape success: target=node-12
```

Aditi (oncall): monitoring metrics — log-ingest queue still elevated (consumer lag ~45k). Suspect downstream kafka consumer disconnected during exporter downtime.

Lina: I'm on kafka consumer. consumer group `log-ingest-group` lag increased because one partition was offline. I'm going to restart consumer deployment `log-ingest-consumer` in `ingest` namespace

Lina: restarted, consumers rebalanced, lag decreasing to 8k and counting

Aditi (oncall): Customer impact: dashboards relying on node metrics delayed ~20-30m; logs ingestion delayed but backfilling underway. Notifying SRE lead and PG if thresholds hit. @support FYI

Tom: re-enable alerts. We need to follow up with deployment CI to pin image tags and add resource limits.

Aditi (oncall): Escalating to oncall rotation lead for post-incident: @Lina to do RCA, @Tom to prepare remediation PR for memory request + image pin. I'll close after 1h stable.

Lina: Will open Jira: SRE-4321 with timeline and root cause (bad image push + missing resource limits)

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident updated: acknowledged by Aditi (oncall). Status: mitigated. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12345

PagerDuty: Incident resolved by Aditi (oncall) — alerts unsuppressed

Aditi (oncall): closing thread; will post RCA when Jira is ready. Great job team :thumbsup:
